title: 攻壳机动队 THE GHOST IN THE SHELL

characters.description: The wise and powerful Head of Section 9, Aramaki relies upon his many international and corporate contacts to supply his team with the information they need to get the job done. Though he commands a great deal of respect, he is occasionally called "Monkey Man" (in the Manga) by his subordinates (perhaps because of his unconventional hairstyle/face). Seldom directly involved in police actions, he is nonetheless constantly working behind the scenes to coordinate the efforts of his agents, making quick and authoritative decisions and maintaining tight control of Kusanagi.

Project 2501, also known as The Puppet Master from the film and manga, Ghost in the Shell is an artificial intelligence program secretly developed by Section 6 of Public Security that develops sapience.

Ishikawa is the information warfare/technology specialist in Public Security Section 9. It has not been stated in the series thus far as to the degree that he has been cybernetically augmented, though character dialogue suggests that he is one of the least augmented members of Section 9. His appearance is characterized by a large beard and perpetually unkempt hair, and he is the oldest of Section 9's field operatives. He formerly served with Kusanagi and Batou in South America when they were with the Ground Self-Defense Forces in the Japanese UN contingent. He was one of the earliest members recruited to be in Section 9 and seems to know the Major and her dislikes quite well. He is shown as being in charge of a gambling parlor called Parlor Ishikawa, and on occasion uses the cyberbrains of the old men who play there to complete particularly heavy data gathering, though it seems the men suffer no ill effects or are even aware of their situation. Ishikawa in terms of personality is the most seemingly laid-back member of the unit. (Source: Wikipedia)

Among the members of Section 9 he is regarded as one of the least cyberized. He can handle any automatic firearm with deadly accuracy and precision, but his primary role is as the unit's tactical sniper. His left eye was replaced with the "Hawkeye", a prosthetic eye that interfaces with satellites to allow for shots of incredible accuracy. He is also valued for his ability to think like enemy snipers; on two separate occasions his ability at determining sniping locations impacted Section 9's actions.

A Fuchikoma is a 1-man tank (walker/roller) used by members of Section 9 of the National Public Safety Commission. They also appear in slightly altered form as Tachikoma in the anime series. They possess a simple artificial intelligence and can act independently to support their user in combat. When not in use, they exhibit a childlike personality and provide much of the humor in the series, while also being used to elaborate on Shirow's philosophy and ideas. Their AI does not include typical safeguards as they are military hardware, but because they possess emotions, they are closely monitored for signs of instability. The Fuchikomas within Section 9 are synchronized nightly or after missions to share their experiences and allow the entire group to learn from them. Mechanically, they have four legs and two simple hands with three fingers on extensible arms which double as machine guns. The "face" consists of a large main lens and two smaller sensors with a "mouth" below, which is commonly a grenade launcher but sometimes a heavier machine gun. The pilot sits in a hunched position inside a large posterior pod with interface cables leading to the standard ports in the user's neck for direct control, but the Fuchikoma can also be given orders to act without a pilot. They can handle many different types of terrain, and are able to walk up walls, rappel, walk, or extend wheels from their feet to drive. They are also submersible. Fuchikomas were removed from Mamoru Oshii's Ghost in the Shell movie, though a large relative of the Fuchikoma known as a "think tank" appears near the end of the movie. In the TV series Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex, they are replaced by Tachikomas which act similarly, but look different, standing taller, and instead of a single large "eye" lens, they have 4 independent rotating sensor pods with 3 sensors each. The AI of Tachikomas is considerably more advanced. At the end of the TV series Ghost in the Shell: S.A.C. 2nd GIG the Tachikomas sacrifice their AI's in order to prevent a nuclear detonation. They are replaced by Fuchikoma/Tachikoma hybrids, referred to as Uchikomas. (source: Ghost in the Shell wikia)

title: 更衣人偶坠入爱河 第二季

characters.description: Akira was passionate about anime and manga in her childhood but due to her mother and classmates' ill views towards this hobby she had to leave her love for manga and anime. Few years later, when she was reunited with some of her classmates that were into anime, she started hanging out with them and discovered her love of anime and manga again, with this she also started cosplaying different characters with her friends to show them her gratitude.
Amane Himeno is a cosplay name, his real name is Chitose Amano. He always cosplays as female characters. Unlike Marin who makes costume from scratch, he purchases costume as finished product.
[Wakana](https://anilist.co/character/133678)'s grandfather.
A character from the manga "I'm a Mega-Best-Selling High-School-Student Light Novel Author That Has a Succubus Thirsting for Me Every Night and I Don't Know What to Do."
Suzuka is a photographer who often attends cosplay events. She gets overly excited by a variety of cosplay. She gets especially excited by cross-playing.

title: 一拳超人 第三季

characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Weapon Transformation __Occupation:__ Hero, Athlete __Level:__ B-Class: Rank 71 Captain Mizuki is a tall woman of fit, muscular stature. Her long dark orange hair is tied in a high ponytail with a scrunchie and she has a band aid on the left side of her face and wears earrings. She wears a tight blue spandex top with a single stripe on each side, blue shorts with the initials "MZK" on it and decorates her attire by wearing three medals around her neck. __Personality:__ Mizuki is a dutiful hero, she also appears to have a cheerful and bubbly side, being excited about the prospect of receiving a promotion but despite now being a hero, she still acts as if she's still an athlete in many ways. She's also a very cheerful and sunny girl. __Abilities:__ As a B-Class hero, Mizuki is fairly powerful, but she's strong enough to crush and decapitate various monsters who were either Wolf or Tiger Level. Mizuki carries a baton that she changes the shape of with "Anchor Baton" written on it. It can extend a great distance and the tip can sharpen so that it can become a javelin, It was specially made for her by the Hero Association. (Source: One Punch Man Wiki)

Kaijin Hime Do-S is a female dominatrix monster of the Monster Association who uses her whip to turn her opponents into love slaves. She is able to enslave the Blizzard Bunch, but Blizzard herself is able to resist.

aliases: Earth's Strongest Swordmaster (地球最強の剣聖)
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Master Swordsmanship __Occupation:__ Superhero, Swordsmanship Teacher __Affiliation:__ Hero Association, Council of Swordmasters __Level:__ S-Class Rank 4 __Personality:__ Atomic Samurai has a rather prideful and jocular personality as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces, Kamikaze also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky. __Abilities:__ Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes. He is regarded as one of the most powerful of them, and the strongest backup hero in the Hero Association, he is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. Atomic Samurai possesses extreme levels of speed, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye using his sword.

Black Sperm is an arrogant yet insecure monster. He is very confident in his abilities, shown in his willingness to take on Monster King [Orochi](https://anilist.co/character/126979/Orochi), but he dislikes when other people "look down on him" for his appearance or personality, and if he senses that someone is doing so, he becomes furious. At the same time, he is willing to work with others in order to take on a stronger opponent, shown by his cooperation with the Monster Association.

**Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero Superalloy Blackluster is a large, bald man with round eyes and a defined jawline. He is very muscular, with a thick neck, large and well-defined pectoral and abdominal muscles and large, muscular arms.

title: 我的英雄学院 最终季

characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to [Stain](https://anilist.co/character/126067). Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods. ~!It is later revealed that Dabi is Touya Todoroki (轟燈矢), the eldest son of the Pro Hero [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) and his wife [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/150628/Todoroki-Rei), and the older brother to [Shouto Todoroki](https://anilist.co/character/89220/Todoroki-Shouto). For a significant period of time, his whereabouts were unknown.!~

__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 7¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.3 - former, No.2 - current) __Quirk:__ Fierce Wings __Affiliation:__ Hero Public Safety Commission, ~!Paranormal Liberation Front (as a spy)!~ Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting. He believes that popular approval is the most important metric a Pro Hero should be judged for, and does not appear to take the official rankings seriously, showing a preference for the lower ranks as it would allow him to act more freely and avoid the burdens of being a top hero. He states his wish to patrol in a leisurely fashion and "take it easy". It is hinted that Hawks was a fan of [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) from an early age, as depicted by the drawing of him as a child holding an Endeavor figurine.

__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery. Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527/Togata-Mirio) is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

title: 间谍过家家 第三季

aliases: Nafalia Foney (トバリー・フォニー)
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm __Occupation:__ Hospital Assistant (secretly a spy) A spy who works undercover as an assistant to [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) at Berlint General Hospital to provide him with mission details. Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, even telling Loid to replace [Yor](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Forger-Yor) and let her take over the role of the Forger wife.
Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

characters.native: メリンダ・デズモンド
characters.description: Mother to [Damian](https://anilist.co/character/150424/) and wife to [Donovan](https://anilist.co/character/180192/)

characters.native: ユーイン・エッジバーグ
characters.description: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy. He is a loyal person, devotedly following Damian, almost always holding his bag when they walk to class. He also genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for Damian when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

The 6-year-old son of a major in the National Army who attends Eden Academy as part of Wald Hall. He was given the nickname "Bazooka Bill" by his peers for his mental and physical domination in sports since nursery school.

title: 石纪元 SCIENCE FUTURE

characters.description: Byakuya Ishigami was a Japanese astronaut who was residing on the International Space Station when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He was a kind, playful, and mischievous man who always found a way to amuse himself and keep things lighthearted, no matter the stakes. ~!He was [Senku Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s adoptive father.!~

Ruri is [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku)'s elder sister and the daughter of [Kokuyo](https://anilist.co/character/150509/Kokuyo), and serves as the priestess of Ishigami Village. She is similar to Kohaku in appearance but has longer hair and a more hourglass-shaped body. She wears a black sundress and a piece of rope around her neck.

__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9") Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Luna is a slender young woman of average height who has somewhat wild, short blonde hair with a few locks long enough to cover her left eye, similar to [Ginro](https://anilist.co/character/143270). She has a small bust but extremely wide hips and is considered to be very attractive by [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/187009), [Max](https://anilist.co/character/187010), [Mozu](https://anilist.co/character/157298), and several others. For clothing, she wears a striped, form-fitting short backless dress and a choker with a star on it. She also has a pouch wrapped around her left thigh and a pair of thigh-high boots with heels. Her petrification scar takes the form of a star shape on her lower back. ~!Luna is one of the residents of the American colony.!~
Kirisame is one of the two strongest warriors in the Petrification Kingdom, the other being [Mozu](https://anilist.co/character/157298).

title: 彻夜之歌 第二季

characters.description: A private detective with an odd personality. Likes to smoke when she is not solving cases. ~!Ten years ago, she went by her real name Kyouko Mejiro and was a member of a literature club at the school [Nico Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/175657) taught the night class of. She became [Nazuna Nanakusa](https://anilist.co/character/168774)'s first friend until her father was turned into a vampire, causing both parents to die and Kyouko to quit school and disappear.!~

Akira Asai is the childhood friend of [Kou](https://anilist.co/character/168866/ ) and [Mahiru Seki](https://anilist.co/character/269129/Mahiru-Seki), and also lives in the same apartment complex as Kou. Akira is a disciplined student who obediently follows her school duties. She is friendly and maintains a close relationship with Kou and Mahiru. Her suspicion of vampires is strong and so she doesn't really want to have much to do with them. She is seemingly very attached to Kou and often lets him get her into trouble.
Seri Kikyou is a vampire and a gyaru that seeks enjoyment in life and finds it increasingly challenging to have fun.

She is a vampire and a friend in [Nico Hirata's](https://anilist.co/character/175657/Niko-Hirata) clique. ~!Before becoming a vampire, Kabura was a very sick, but kind person, who couldn't go out with her friends much, and stayed in the hospital with Haru Nanakusa, as anything her friends want her to do were too much energy for her. Later, she wanted a way out of the hatred and neglect from both family and friends, so she agreed on the request of being turned into a vampire by Haru.!~
Midori Kohakobe is a vampire and the number 1 maid at the maid cafe Vamps.

title: 坂本日常 后篇

characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm Heisuke Mashimo is a low-ranking assassin whose main skill is sharpshooting. Heisuke ended up losing his job, causing him to seek out [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Tarou-Sakamoto)'s bounty in order to turn his luck around.

Gaku is an extremely powerful assassin under [Slur](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki). He wields a long cube-headed mace, the tip of which contains a powerful cannon. He usually covers this weapon with bandages. ~!He was able to massacre hundreds of JAA members and hold his own against [Takamura](https://anilist.co/character/272875/), an especially strong Order member. However he does permanently lose his right ear as a result of this fight.!~
__Height:__ 164 cm Akira Akao is one of the examinees taking part in the JCC Exam. She is the niece of [Rion Akao](https://anilist.co/character/288224), Nagumo's and Sakamoto's old classmate.

__Height:__ 179 cm Uzuki, also known as Slur, is a killer seeking to overthrow the JAA. Roughly around the same time [Tarou Sakamoto's](https://anilist.co/character/196522) bounty was put up, Uzuki murdered a quarter of the assassin industry. The Order deemed him "X" as he leaves a large red 'X' at the scene of his crimes.
An old man carrying a katana. He is an assassin from The Order, a group consisting of the strongest members within the JAA.

title: 防风少年 第二季

characters.description: Kotoha works at Café Pothos. Her friendly and brave personality makes her seem like an adult, but just like Sakura and the others, she’s only 16. As manager of Café Pothos, she serves the best menu to the students at Furin High School and the local townspeople everyday. She will admonish Sakura for his actions from time to time. (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

__Height:__ 165cm A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Toshiyuki’s gentle-mannered personality and thoughtfulness make him popular with the ladies, but he’s no pushover — his fighting abilities are the real deal. A lover of games, he'll play them whenever he has some free time, making it his daily routine to try and get game login bonuses. He likes to add “chan” to his close friends’ names as a term of endearment. He is revered as one of the five strongest of his grade. (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website, edited)

__Height:__ 188cm Endo is a laid-back young man that is always shown to have a carefree and warm nature when fighting. ~!Later, it is revealed that Endo he is a very dangerous individual that, not only is extremely careful with Chika Takiishi, but also reveres him as a god. He believes that he was born to see Takiishi fight, hence why he follows Takiishi around. He is shown to be extremely aggressive if things don’t go his way, revealing his troubled obsession with being pleased. !~

A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. One of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Hiragi is the leader of the Tamon Team. Hiragi is highly strung and possesses a strong sense of responsibility, often finding himself being pushed around by the overly gracious Umemiya. He's also a hard worker who can't let go of his stomach pain medicine. He possesses true martial arts ability, proven to be one of the best at his craft. He is an understanding person who loyally supports Umemiya. (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

__Height:__ 181 cm A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Always lifting weights and never without his protein shake, Tsugeura possesses a bright and honest personality that makes all his friends admire him. However, due to his constant state of high energy, his friends can also find him to be a pain in the butt at times. A lover of "virtues" as a way of life, he asks everyone he meets for the first time about their virtues. He’s a regular at the Muscle Power restaurant and recommends their protein okonomiyaki. (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

title: 魔女与使魔

characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") A witch. Clumsy and goofy, she has a tendency to let compliments go straight to her head. Her dream is to be a great witch who helps others. Due to being the Witch of Thousand, a type of witch that is born every 1000 years that is able to use various spells unlike normal witches, she is targeted by a group of Black Witches. Her childhood friend and first love, [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/), is assigned the task of being her familiar and protecting her from harm.

__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A witch from a venerable household who specializes in shape-shifting magic and can turn into a cat. Falling asleep turns her back. She wants to make [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) her familiar.

__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") An ogre. Strong and level-headed, he's had his hands full ever since his childhood friend [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) returned. Nico's nickname for him is "Moi."

__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") Nico's classmate and self-proclaimed hipster. He was a figure skater until an accident forced him to retire. ~!He's actually a werewolf, and seeing any crescent shape brings out his other [personality](https://anilist.co/character/301197/).!~

__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") A tengu. Due to clan differences, he didn't like [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) at first. He's highly sociable and makes friends easily. He joins the Otogi household as [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) familiar.

title: 青春猪头少年不会梦到圣诞服女郎

characters.description: A beautiful college girl in Sakuta's class. She follows trends and dresses up, but rather than to impress she does it exclusively for herself. Like Sakuta, she doesn't own a phone and is not easily dissuaded—has declared herself a potential friend.

Sakuta's classmate from middle school who seems to share a troubled past with him. She currently attends the same college as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta). She's highly intelligent, and appears to have a number of secrets.
__Height:__ 161cm A miniskirt-wearing Santa calling herself "Touko Kirishima". She claims she's been handing out presents—Adolescence Syndrome.
__Height:__ 154 cm A first-year student at Minegahara High with excellent grades, and one of Sakuta's students at cram school.
A Minegahara first-year in Sakuta's cram school class. She appears to have an interest in Kento, another of Sakuta's students.

title: 盾之勇者成名录 第四季

characters.description: A cursed slave of Naofumi Iwatani and the sister of Fohl. She carries a hereditary illness in which she cannot see or walk, and has an expected short life expectancy. Naofumi, however, restores her health with a Yggrasil Medicine, curing her. She is still blind but can sense the ki of other beings. Due to Naofumi being her savior, she holds strong romantic feelings toward him. ~!Atla later dies. Soon after her death, Naofumi absorbed her into his shield. She then becomes a spirit the resides within the Legendary Shield.!~

__Race:__ Killer Whale Sadeena was born and grew up in Q'ten Lo islands in a special lineage related to the devotion of the God Water Dragon and the Heavenly Emperor. At some point in her adolescence, she became the head priest of the Water Dragon and became friends with the heir of Q'ten Lo throne, Raphtalia's father. After that, under unknown circumstances, she decided to follow Raphtalia's parents when they decided to elope from the country, leaving behind her old life. After leaving their country, she and Raphtalia's parents settle down in Melromarc's Seaetto territory, as the governor was receiving great quantities of immigrants as part of the Queen's initiative to create a Demi-human protected district. Once she rescued Keel from drowning in the ocean. Sadeena went far away for fishing, in times of wave, unable to return in time to rescue the villagers. Raphtalia and the surviving villagers believe that the catastrophe of the wave and it's monster could be subsumed if Sadeena was present. Sadeena herself regrets not being there in the village in times of the wave.
She serves as an overseer for Naofumi Iwatani's village. Eclair also serves as a martial arts instructor for Naofumi's slaves.
S'yne Lokk is one of the Vassal Wielders of a fallen world. She now lives in Raphtalia's World, she is the Sewing Hero. (Source: Shield-Hero Wiki)
A cursed slave of Naofumi Iwatani and the brother of Atla.

title: 碧蓝之海 第二季

characters.description: Azusa Hamaoka is a third-year at Oumi University and is a part of the intercollegiate diving club with Izu University. Known for her very outgoing and exhibitionist personality, she displays particular friendship/comradeship to Iori.

She is a student at Oumi Women's University and the coworker of Iori Kitahara and Naomi Otoya. She has a crush on Otoya Naomi. ~!She was cheered up by Iori after Naomi rejected her confession. Soon after that, she has developed romantic feelings for Iori, of which he is unaware. She lip-locked him in front of Chisa and Aina during their second trip to Okinawa islands.!~

Iori's Elder Cousin. When Iori comes to Grand Blue he doesn't recognise her at first since she had become very beautiful and gets attracted to her only to find out later that she has become a siscon who smells her younger sister Chisa's after worn clothes and takes her photo all the time.
He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.
He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.

title: 转生为第七王子，随心所欲的魔法学习之路 第二季

characters.description: [Lloyd](https://anilist.co/character/290877/de-Saloum-Lloyd)'s loyal maid, who serves the Kingdom of Saloum. In charge of his education and his protection. Has mastery with a blade that adventurers envy, along with the alias "The Silver Blade Princess." Seems very kind at first, but rigorous when it comes to training with a sword. She was a cold-hearted swordswoman in the past, and during battle that side of her surfaces. (Source: Official Site)

The Pain Blighted, whose ability allows her to link with anyone she sees, at which point she and her target will share any injuries either suffers. Given the nature of her power, she often harms herself as a tactic in battle, earning her the name "Talia the Hundred Pains." She has a self-sacrificing personality where she will endure pain willingly for the sake of her friends. She loves gossip, and often takes care of Ren as the only other girl in the guild. (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

A kind-hearted nun serving at a church in the Dane district of the Kingdom of Saloum. Renowned for her beautiful singing voice and her ability to heal others, Escher has a past connection with Lloyd. (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

The Warp Blighted, whose joints are unnaturally flexible, allowing him to fit through even the smallest of spaces, like a rodent, earning him the name "Babylon the Giant Rat." A master of martial arts that utilizes his body's flexibility, he is recognizable by his small eyes that conceal his emotions. During combat he will laugh in a way that antagonizes his enemies. Though he seems aloof, much like the rest of the guild, he cares greatly for his companions, and is known for keeping a cool head, as well being a reliable decision maker. (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

The fourth princess of the Kingdom of Saloum and Lloyd’s older sister. She is deeply knowledgeable about music and has mastered various instruments but shows little interest in anything outside of music. Her performances with Escher are highly acclaimed, enchanting not only people but even the gods. (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

title: 持续狩猎史莱姆三百年 第二季

characters.description: A high-ranking demon known as the Lord of the Flies and the demons' minister of agriculture. She frequently shuttles between the demon realm and the house in the highlands. She's [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s reliable "big sister" surrogate.

Flatorte is a cheerful, energetic blue dragon girl who obeys what [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa) says. Since she's a dragon like [Laika](https://anilist.co/character/135593/Laika), there is somewhat of a rivalry between them, but she's an optimistic and energetic girl. Unlike Laika, she has a tail in human form.
Oldest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and math.
Youngest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and history.

characters.native: プロヴァト・ペコラ・アリエース
characters.description: The Demon King. A girl with a devilish temperament who loves to use her power and influence to bewilder her subordinates and Azusa. She actually has a masochistic desire to be subordinate to someone stronger than she is, and she adores Azusa.

title: 赛马娘 芦毛灰姑娘

characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute! Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

__Height:__ 146 cm Belno Light is a teammate of [Oguri Cap.](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) She is skilled at studying, which allows her to excel at providing insight and analysis. Her family runs a major company specializing in sports goods for Uma Musume, which gives her deep knowledge about racing equipment.

__Height:__ 168 cm Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing. No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

__Height:__ 164 cm Keeping it old-school! A real hot rod! A dashing Umamusume with a sisterly demeanor and a retro way of speaking. She is a speed demon who adores the pure joy of the wind in her face. On the road, her hot rod is the one burning rubber, but in a race, it's her own two feet tearing up the track. Despite her tremendous power, she isn't pompous, and is well-liked by everyone. In Uma Musume: Pretty Derby she is member of Team Rigil.

__Height:__ 170 cm Fujimasa March is a scholarship student at the Kasamatsu Training Academy. She was considered the best in her class and set her sights on winning the Tokai Derby. [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) is the first person she would consider as a rival.

title: CITY THE ANIMATION

characters.description: Wako Izumi is an air-headed young lady who is never seen without a smile. She is often engrossed in minor things, completely ignoring her surroundings and oblivious to both obstacles and her mistakes.

Midori Nagumo is an energetic and headstrong college student who recently moved to the City. She hates responsibility and avoids it at all costs. Her best friend is [Niikura](https://anilist.co/character/127011/Niikura), whom she constantly pesters for money. She's usually identifiable by her ponytail and blue hoodie. Her irrational behavior annoys everyone around her.

Niikura is Nagumo's best friend and roommate. Nagumo constantly asks her for money. She is more responsible than Nagumo, but her constant dealing with Nagumo's antics has left her with a short temper. She owns a yellow scooter that she rides around the City. She is an aspiring photographer.

Riko Izumi is a student in class 2-3 at CITY South High School and [Wako Izumi's](https://anilist.co/character/127010/Wako-Izumi) younger sister. She is often seen to be sleep-deprived and would often fall asleep whenever given the chance. Unbeknownst to her, she is able to capture the hearts of everyone who interacts with her in the city, even garnering a fan club composed of various city residents in an attempt to smooth out any potential conflict from anyone striving after their mutual crush. Despite her obliviousness of her surroundings thanks to her usual lack of sleep, she seems to have an affinity with robotics, as she have constructed several robots in her youth and have even shown to be a capable hacker, a skill that her sister relied upon to disable the machine utilized by the [Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/180034/Tsurubishi-Makabe)-[Adatara](https://anilist.co/character/180164/Adatara-Hakase) pair.

The owner and head chef of Makabe's Western Bistro. He has a nonchalant, apathetic attitude, and doesn't care enough to deal with details. Despite his apparent lack of motivation, everyone knows that he won't put up with disobedience. He ends up hiring an unwilling Nagumo when Tatewaku tells him she offered to work for the restaurant. Also known as "Chef Makabe" for simplicity's sake. (Source: CITY Wiki)

title: 中年大叔转生反派千金

characters.native: グレイス・オーヴェルヌ
characters.description: The daughter of [Duke Auvergne](https://anilist.co/character/349682/Auvergne-Leopold) and the villainess in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast". In her past life, used to be a 52 years old man called Kenzaburou Tondabayashi, who worked as a civil servant. Thanks to her "old man" wisdom, her "elegance cheat" and her experience as an ex-parent, she gives counsels to many people within the academy.

Anna is the protagonist of the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast." She comes from a commoner family and earned the top score on the Royal Magic Academy's entrance exams. In the original game, she has a terrible relationship with [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) due to their conflicting personalities, but after Kenzaburou becomes Grace, Anna ends up admiring her.

Josette is an apprentice maid of the Auvergne household. She makes many mistakes and was often scolded by [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) to the point where she was convinced she would be fired if she made another mistake. The shift in Grace's personality made her extremely confused.
Hinako is [Kenzaburo's](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) daughter. She is an otaku like both of her parents, and enjoys otome games like Magical Academy: Love and Beast.

Mitsuko is [Kenzaburo's](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) wife. She is an extreme otaku like the rest of her family, with a strong interest in isekai stories in her student days, so she is quick to accept her husband's situation.

title: 无职转生 第二季 Part 2

characters.native: パウロ・グレイラット
characters.description: Paul Greyrat is the father of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat), [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Greyrat-Norn) and [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Greyrat-Aisha). He is both a talented man that became advanced in all three sword arts at a young age and a lustful man that attracts and sleeps with many women before [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) chained him down.

Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat). ~!After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!~

characters.native: アリエル・アネモイ・アスラ
aliases: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom
characters.description: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at the Ranoa Magic Academy.

Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus. Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

aliases: Child of Bazar of the Holy Steel and Lilitella of the Beautiful Snow Ridge
聖鉄のバザル と 美しき雪稜のリリテッラ の子
characters.description: Juliette is an orphaned Dwarf and slave purchased by Rudeus and Zanoba with the purpose of helping them in the making of dolls. She was acquired because she fit the criteria of being a child, a Dwarf and by being a Dwarf having dexterous hands, which is preferable in doll-making. She's wary of Rudeus to an extent because of him befitting the behaviour of a folklore individual characterised by typical traits parents tell their children to deter them.

title: 欢迎来到实力至上主义的教室 第三季

characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") He is the leader of the school council and is [Horikita Suzune](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune)'s elder brother.

She is a student of class 1-D. ~!In Volume 7.5, Maya asks for [Kei Karuizawa](https://anilist.co/character/141122/Karuizawa-Kei)'s help to plan her "date" with [Kiyotaka Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). Kei was surprised and suggested other boys to her, but she refused, and said that she only liked Kiyotaka. She told her plan to Kei and made some changes according to her suggestions. She then later asked Kei if they could make it a "double-date", by including her and [Yousuke Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) in the plan. Eventually, Kei agreed and decided to schedule the double date on December 25. She confessed to Kiyotaka after the double date during Christmas, but was rejected and ran away crying. They promised each other that they will hang out again in the future and wants to see each other again but Maya couldn’t hold her feelings and excused herself first as she didn’t want him to see her in a pathetic state. She was hinted to have cried an innumerable amount of times behind closed doors after being rejected as the next time we saw her, she was able to frankly tell her friends she was rejected without being choked up. Her friends summarised that this could only had happened if she had come to terms with the rejection showing an immense amount of willpower to move on. That said, she still harbours feelings for Kiyotaka and has admitted that she finds him way cooler and hotter than Hirata not holding against Kei for liking the same person. She still feels conflicted that her best friend was in a relationship with her crush but decided to uphold their secret and support them in whatever way she can.!~ ~!Maya has below average academic abilities as was apparent during the Paper Shuffle special exam. Her physical abilities are of the lower echelon as well. However, she is one of more popular girls in her class. Although not to the tier of Kei, many observers were astonished to see someone like her talk to and publicly flirt with the 'uninteresting' Kiyotaka. She is also out-going and not afraid to take risks such as confessing to Kiyotaka on their first date.!~

Haruka is a pretty normal person, but she is not very open to other people as shown when she didn't participate in the class's swimming session where she tends to prefer keeping to herself and not bothering people, simply to avoid trouble. She is considered to have good looks and is often viewed lustfully by boys, thus wanting to seclude herself. She is mostly seen wearing the school's uniform, with the difference that she has the upper button of her shirt undone and her tie relatively loosened. She prefers giving people nicknames the moment she meets them, which is said by Kushida to be a method for her "to appear closer to the people she isn't close to". ~! In Year 2, Volume 5, Haruka is told off by Kushida when she tries to help the latter. She is then seen aggressively opposing the motion by Ayanokoji to expel Airi Sakura, being her closest friend, to no avail. She is one of the 4 remaining members and the sole remaining girl of the Ayanokoji Group.!~

Mio Ibuki is a student of class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.

__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8") The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

title: 关于我转生变成史莱姆这档事 第三季

characters.description: Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students. She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

characters.native: ルミナス・バレンタイン
characters.description: "Queen of Nightmares" Luminous Valentine is an elite vampire and one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords. She is also the true ruler of the Holy Kingdom Ruberion.

Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/132755/Kagurazaka-Yuuki) and Class S, she's a former student of [Shizue Izawa](https://anilist.co/character/128037/Shizu). ~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~
Guy Crimson is the oldest of the Demon Lords. He has forever ruled over the frozen continent. Being androgynous, he can become a man or woman at will.
One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.

title: 勇者赫鲁库

characters.description: __Height:__ 152cm (5') __Power level:__ 78 One of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Empire. Has a hair-trigger temper, but is big-hearted underneath. The serious one of the group, she usually gets caught up in Helck and Piwi's shenanigans. She can use fire and summoning magic and excells at fighting several enemies simultaneously.

__Height:__ 200cm (6'7") __Power level:__ 99 The titular human hero Helck. He is the older brother of the hero Cless. Immensely strong, reliable, and capable, Helck seeks to become the champion of demons and destroy the humans.

Piwi is a round pure green fluffy bird like creature. Piwi is raucous and very ignorant. Yet, he has been described with a "cute" personality. He is very carefree, sometimes even oblivious to the violence that occurs around him.

Alicia is a close friend of Helck. She is a mercenary that Helck met on his journey to Edil's home. She comes from a long line of mercenaries. She was told that one of her ancestors was a hero that fought demons before the current Human Empire was founded. (Source: helck.fandom.com)

Asuta is full of curiosity, so she takes interest in lots of things. She is very cautious about her surroundings and always takes extra precautions to ensure success, such as using tools that her natural abilities can already accomplish. She is quick to jump to a conclusion if it means something poses as a possible danger.

title: 黑执事 马戏团篇

characters.description: Joker first appears in the Circus Arc in Kuroshitsuji, and is part of Noah’s Ark Circus which is suspected in the case of the missing children. Joker first appears to be the Ringleader in the Noah's Arks Circus, but is later revealed that he is more like " a hired shop keeper", but most of the carnies still refer to him as the boss as he directs the main show in the circus. He also has one of his hands missing for an unknown reason in his youth and is replaced with a prosthetic hand made by the Circus doctor.

Snake is a young, relatively skinny male with short white hair with a cowlick, who appears to have small patches of scales all over his body. Snake is quiet, rarely speaking, and when he does, it's usually to relay information from one of his snakes. Joker tells Ciel Phantomhive and Sebastian Michaelis that "Snake an' his friends're still shy" and warns them to be careful of "their poison. However, he seems to have a bit of a playful side, as he flirts Dagger through one of his snakes. He seems to care enough about the other first-tier members to provide information and warnings, as shown when he apologizes to Doll for allowing his snakes to roam loose. However, he delayed in telling the others about Ciel's and Sebastian's invasion of their tents for an unknown reason, and he is not shown referring to the other first-tier members as brothers or sisters, as they do. He also does not accompany them on their missions, and doesn't seem to be fully informed as to what they're doing when they're gone. Furthermore, he seems to dislike being in positions of authority, as when the second-tier members question where the other first-tier members are at, he relays only small bits of information before leaving the decisions to the others. (Source: Kuroshitsuji Wiki)

Dagger is one of the Carnies at Noahs Ark Circus, his Circus trick is a knife Thrower, he never misses his target and uses this to fight. When Ciel joins the Circus as Smile, Dagger helps train him up. Dagger keeps a cheery mood thoughout the manga. He is closest with Joker and has a not-so-secret attraction to Beast, who makes it obvious that she prefers Joker.

Known only by his profession, the Undertaker is a mysterious man whose scarred face is never fully visible beneath his long hair and crooked top hat. He occasionally provides information to [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel). While he finds Ciel amusing and enjoys helping him out, he has nothing but disdain for the [Queen](https://anilist.co/character/20367/Victoria-Joou). He tends to punctuate his words with sweeping gestures and creepy giggles and seems to spend a good deal of time inside of coffins. He also likes to hear jokes and ask people to tell him for exchanging information.

He is the creator of the Noah's Ark Circus and is referred to as Father by the tier-one performers. Except for his left eye, his entire face is covered by bandages. ~!He appears to have a great affection for children and uses his circus as a means to lure them. He then brainwashes them and has act them as his servants. However, he does not care for their well-being and even finds it entertaining when he has them die gruesomely while performing in a circus without training.!~ He knew Ciel as a small boy and recreates the room Ciel was branded and caged in as a child. He is infatuated with Ciel, blushing and saying it is like a dream to have Ciel beside him. ~!It is insinuated that because of this infatuation he has kidnaps children. When he first met Ciel, he believed he was too ugly and underwent many surgeries for Ciel, only to believe it a waste when he heard the Phantomhive had been killed. He is later killed by Ciel and his mansion is burned by Sebastian.!~

title: 战国妖狐

characters.description: Shinsuke was just a traveling ronin when he met Jinka and Tama. He was fascinated with their abilities and offered information to be able to follow them.

Senya is a demon hunter with his father Jinun. Senya was experimented on and given 1000 demons inside of his body by the Dangaishu ~!In the second half of the manga, he later becomes the main character of the series. With Tama, Tsukiko, and Nau, they try to free Jinka.!~

Raidou is a ronin hired by the Dangaishu to kill demons. He's given his nickname The Demon Eater because he usually eats and sells demon meat. Raidou uses two swords, a katana named Maken that can manipulate wind and a short katana named Wakizashi. ~!Raidou eventually retires from demon hunting due to the injuries sustained in his fight against Jinka and later becomes Shinsuke's teacher also passing down Maken to him.!~

A very ambitious and sassy several hundred year old fox katawara. Alongside her human brother, [Jinka](https://anilist.co/character/27221/Jinka-Yamato), she travels the lands in order to try and rid the world of humans and katawara committing evil deeds and spread peace and kindness.

A fused being, she is half Shakuyaku (human), and Kagan (katawara). Shakugan often looks like a human, but she can change her limbs to huge rock pillars at will. Shakuyaku was a country girl that lived in poverty with her family, until she was discovered to have hidden powers and was thus sold by her parents to the monastery. She was subjected to experimental merging of a human and a katawara, and fused with Kagan, a golem katawara. However, the process went haywire and she lost control and any physical traces of her humanity, escaping and killing many people while in a daze, including her family. After she managed to recover, she was now Shakugan.

title: 堀与宫村 -piece-

characters.description: A close friend of [Kyouko Hori's](https://anilist.co/character/66171/Kyouko-Hori) who attends the same high school as her.

__Height:__ 158 cm A member of the Student Council and she is known as the girlfriend of Kakeru Sengoku who attends Katagiri Senior High School where she is enrolled in class 3-5. She is more of a mascot in the student council, and is shown to do little to no work at all. Remi is usually shown as a rather childish and immature girl who has a very straightforward personality, and often wears her emotions on her sleeve. And seems to rely on other people's help. She's also not very smart, often compared to [Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Miyamura-Izumi) about which one is more of an idiot. She loves insects, though she's bad with dragonflies. Her room is filled with her insect collection, and she has been nicknamed the Insect Queen. She also enjoys reading, especially fairy tales. She's also comically bad at cooking, just like [Kakeru Sengoku](https://anilist.co/character/72447/Sengoku-Kakeru).
__Height:__ 180 cm Kyousuke is Kyouko's father who is often not home because of work.

__Height__: 174 cm Tooru is friendly with everyone, and has a calm personality. He attends Katagiri Senior Highschool. ~!At first he hates Miyamura due to his close relationship with Hori, who he had a crush on at the time. He confessed to her and was immediately rejected. In time he became a great friend of Miyamura.!~

__Height:__ 168 cm He is a 3rd year at Katagiri High School​ and a member of Hori and Miyamura's regular group of friends. He is enrolled in class 3-6. He has very bad eyesight and cannot see properly without his glasses.

title: 为美好的世界献上爆焰

characters.description: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

Wiz is the owner of a famous Magic Item Shop in Axel that has many unsalable items with quirky defects. She used to be a renowned Arch Wizard, but has since retired. At night, she has a secret identity as a kind-hearted lich who helps lingering spirits pass on. She is also the only harmless Demon King's General and prefers to live as a human.

aliases: Shikkoku no Majuu (しっこくの魔獣)
characters.description: Chomusuke acts as [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent. ~!She is actually the other half of Lady Wolbach, who was sealed in the Crimson Demon Village.!~

Eris is the Goddess of Fortune and [Aqua's](https://anilist.co/character/89362) junior. Eris is a very kind and gentle girl who treats others with kindness and respect. She is also very caring and she always interest her adherents. She has a very cheerful attitude but at times can act a bit childish. She is insecure about her breast size and uses breast pads to compensate. Aqua often embarrasses her with this knowledge, as Eris wants as few people as possible to notice her lack in bust. She is also kind-hearted and gentle, and therefore, her scent is very fragrant, according to her peers and Aegis. ~!Eris disguises herself as Chris, a friend to [Darkness](https://anilist.co/character/89363) listed under the occupation of thief. Chris is an innocent, cheerful and energetic girl that is almost always seen with a big smile and boasting a bright personality. She also seems to have high confidence in herself. Though at times she acts quite childish and mischievous, Chris has a big, kind heart.!~
Komekko is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s adorable younger sister. She is a young Crimson Demon and the only Crimson Magic kid around her age.

title: 虚构推理 第二季

characters.description: She has an appearance of a very beautiful woman with a smooth, white complexion, fitting her Snowy profile. She has long hair with a mix color of black and white. She often wears a white kimono. She really cares about [Masayuki Muroi](https://anilist.co/character/266166), who she thinks is too kind for a human.

Rikka is [Kurou Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947)'s older cousin and the reason he visited the hospital as regularly as he did. Just like Kuro, she also has the powers of immortality and precognition, although she wants them to be removed and has tried medical science and suicide to no avail. ~!Due to this, she later switches her plan on creating imaginary monsters such as Steel Lady Nanase with god-like powers, hoping that they would eventually be able to turn her back to normal.!~

Because of facing many betrayals from his beloved people, he loses faith in human beings and wants to have an isolated life. In reality, he is a very decent person: he forgives those who betrayed him and does not want to enact any revenge; this makes many people confused about his overkind actions.

She is the daughter of [Ryouma Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/299912), the eldest son of [Gouichi Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/299893). Ryouma had business at his shop, so Rion replaced him to attend Gouichi request.
An old woman who lives with a ghost cat in a small port town. Although she is over eighty, she is in good health and is relied on by the townspeople.

title: 怕痛的我，把防御力点满就对了 第二季

characters.description: Mii is a player in NewWorld Online. She is the guild master of the Flame Emperors guild along side Markus, Misery, and Shin. Mii acquired a skill and unknowingly built up a character with her great charisma that others willingly follow. After realizing this, she became embarrassed to show her true self; a quiet girl who wants to enjoy cute things. She regrets her actions but decided to up appearances for those who chose to follow her.
She plays the production-specialized crafter class, being one of the top crafters in NWO. She joins Maple Tree upon [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s invitation.
Frederica is a member of Payne's Guild, Congregation of the Holy Swords along side Dread and Drag being part of the considerably more powerful players.

Introduced [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) to [Iz](https://anilist.co/character/155754). He is invited to join Maple tree after the guild system was introduced. He is a caring and honest person who is open-minded and serious. Outside of combat, he gives off a strong parental vibe. Like Maple he is part of the Shield class as well as a sword he still tries to master.

Payne is the top player in NewWorld Online and considered to be the strongest. He is the guild master of the Congregation of the Holy Swords alongside [Frederica](https://anilist.co/character/158410/Frederica), [Dread](https://anilist.co/character/158411/Dread), and [Drag](https://anilist.co/character/158415/Drag). Although polite, he sees [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892/Honjou-Kaede) as a rival he aims to defeat in the future.

title: 黄金神威 第四季

characters.description: Ogata is the former Superior Private of the 7th Division and a member of [Hijikata's](https://anilist.co/character/125422/Hijikata-Toshizou) Group. Loyal only to himself, Ogata is pursuing the gold for his own reason, unknown to anyone. Ogata is analytical and coldblooded, a proud sniper who is used to examining things from afar and evaluating circumstances in order to best take advantage of them. Even when at a disadvantage, he keeps his nerve and takes the most efficient course of action. He is also known for his marksmanship, a skill he honed since his childhood. He is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill, although he is aware that wanton slaughter is counterproductive, and would rather escape a fight he can't win than throw himself into it impulsively. On the surface, Ogata is capable of acting amiable and polite; in order to achieve his goals, he can lie and deceive others. He is prone to caustic remarks and may openly look down on some people. Ogata also likes to snark about any perceived absurdity and incompetence, especially if it comes to warfare and keeping one's gun safe. Although he is generally emotionless and indifferent to others, Ogata seems to be a very proud man who doesn't like to be doubted. If challenged, he would attempt to do a task that someone says would be difficult for him. He has a habit of slicking his hair back, as well as exhaling through his nose when praised. ~!Ogata can speak Russian, something which seems to be a secret or not well known, as [Koito](https://anilist.co/character/128971/Koito-Otonoshin) was surprised to hear him speak the language.!~

The Private First Class of the 7th Division and a Matagi of Tohoku. He seems to have a frail and low self-esteem, being shown to cry easily under heavy criticism. Tanigaki is a Japanese man from Akita, around the age of [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) and the Nikaidou twins, with a muscular body and body hair. He has dark brown eyes, short, black hair, a thin beard along his jawline, and thick eyebrows. Since his and Nihei Tetsuzou's fight against Sugimoto's group, he has a little scar on his right cheek from a wound caused by Sugimoto's knife.

Koito Otonoshin is a Second Lieutenant of the 7th Division. Koito is a tall, dark-skinned man with dark hair. He has his side part slicked down to the left. His eyebrows are usually furrowed, with two larger sections towards the center, and furrow wrinkles up his forehead. His eyes are black, thin, and have deep eye bags. Because Koito is from the Satsuma Province, which is located in the southern tip of Japan, his dialect slips out sometimes. This often happens when he is excited or nervous. However, this dialect cannot be understood by most Japanese speakers.

aliases: Demon Vice Commander of the Shinsengumi
characters.description: Hijikata is the vice-commander of the Shinsengumi and leader of his group. Despite being imprisoned for decades, he remains energetic and optimistic. Hijikata is very ambitious despite his old age and plans to take over Hokkaido and create his own country in defiance of Japan. To do so, he takes swift and decisive action to search for the gold. As a former Shinsengumi, Hijikata is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill his opponents. Always smiling, Hijikata is flamboyant and regularly boasts about his ambitions and prowess despite his age. He is civil toward people but merciless against his enemies, always shouting to his men to kill every opponent. Hijikata considers that in battle, the best soldiers are those ready to die fighting.

Vasily is a young, Russian sniper with sharp eyes, a furrowed brow and medium length wavy hair with long sideburns that covers his cheeks and chin. He wears a light ushanka hat, a light waist-belt coat, dark gloves and pants. Vasily also carries a sniper rifle, binoculars and a bag around his shoulders. He is a highly analytical man as seen when he was able to predict Hyakunosuke Ogata's intentions of slowing his party down and constantly tries to put himself in Ogata's shoes in order to figure out his sniping habit. Vasily believes that as a sniper he gets to decide whether his prey lives or dies. This can make him appear somewhat cold and uncaring for his comrades. However, Vasily does not allow himself to be motivated by hatred in order to become an excellent cold-blooded sniper. He seems to dislike arrogant people as seen when Kiroranke willingly step out into the open to save another person, which Vasily interpreted his actions as a dare to shoot him.

title: 文豪野犬 第五季

characters.native: フョードル・ドストエフスキー
characters.description: __Ability:__ Crime and Punishment Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

characters.native: エドガー・アラン・ポオ
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") __Ability:__ Black Cat in the Rue Morgue A member of The Guild who is rarely seen without his pet raccoon, Karl. Poe's ability, Black Cat in the Rue Morgue, can transport someone into a story they're reading. Poe is portrayed as shy but determined. He spent six years on a plot to defeat Ranpo, showing that he will work hard at something he cares about. He often talks too quietly for others to hear. ~!After the Guild War, he forms a rivalrous friendship with Ranpo, and frequently brings him his works to read after Ranpo said he wants to see them.!~

__Height:__ 184 cm (6’0) __Ability:__ The Overcoat Nikolai Gogol is a member of the Decay of Angels. He's a sadist who enjoys putting on a show with his words. He is freakish, vigorous, unrepentant, and quite enigmatic. However, Gogol suggests that his quirky image could or might not be real. The side of him that has no remorse for murdering others is just as genuine as the one who has guilt and is well aware of the unjust and cruel nature of his acts. He joined the Decay of Angels in order to experience what he had always desired: freedom against gravity. The Overcoat, Gogol's ability, allows him to use his coat to manipulate spaces and what emerges from it. It functions essentially as a portal, capable of relocating and moving anything. He may use this to materialize a pillar or to manifest his hand and pistol in a location unrelated to him. The ability is also applicable to living beings.

Sigma is a member of the terrorist organization, "Decay of Angels", and owner of the Sky Casino. His ability is unknown, but stated by Fyodor to be the weakest of the Angels. It may be more support-oriented than combat-oriented because of this. He is shown to be very kind to his customers and to have a sense of pride and ownership over his casino.

__Ability:__ Plum Blossoms in Snow Tecchou Suehiro is a Hunting Dogs special unit member with the ability Plum Blossoms in Snow. Tecchou has a considerably more serious demeanor than his companions, yet he still qualifies as an oddball for his strange preferences in food. He takes his duty as a Hunting Dog earnestly and has a deep sense of justice. He despises the notion of torture and is a highly compassionate person. Tecchou's ability, Plum Blossoms in Snow, lets him enhance the size, shape, and reach of his blade. It is unknown whether he can demonstrate his ability on other weapons. He is said to have the strongest ability in the Hunting Dogs.
